remarks:
Enjoy scenic views of Smokes Creek and local wildlife from this move in ready four bedroom, two bath home set on just under an acre. A private second floor in-law suite includes two bedrooms, a full bathroom, kitchen, and a family room, offering flexibility for guests or extended family.
The first floor features two bedrooms and a fully renovated custom bathroom with a tiled walk-in shower and fireplace. The updated kitchen offers refreshed cabinets, sink, countertops, and flooring, plus included appliances. In the family room, a second fireplace and the home’s original staircase add warmth and character. Each floor has separate gas service and its own hot water tank for added flexibility, while newer windows and furnaces enhance comfort and efficiency. Outside, relax or entertain on the large covered front porch or in the enclosed gazebo. A barn with carport and extra wide driveway provides ample storage and parking. Conveniently located within walking distance of shopping, dining, downtown entertainment, and bus stops, this property combines space, character, and everyday convenience.
